datum_translation_stated_before_the_edit.how_the_pan_follows: the pan is NEVER assigned a pocket number. The pan dims were SOLVED through the module's own chain — pan -> pocket_envelope (pan + 2 x 0.40 tolerance, FUNCTIONAL_CLEARANCE_AT_SEATING_DATUM) -> solve_rect_sharp_wall_for_functional (draft 3.0 deg, rim/floor fillets 0.35, pocket depth 3.40) — iterated until the DERIVED sharp wall at deck equals the measurement exactly.
